Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class RealGasPipeDecompression.ReleaseOpeningProfile

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.RealGasPipeDecompression.ReleaseOpeningProfile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
RealGasPipeDecompression
public static final class RealGasPipeDecompression.ReleaseOpeningProfile extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable prescribed opening history for the release boundary.

The profile scales the maximum discharge coefficient and is evaluated at the midpoint of every accepted finite-volume substep. It supplies deterministic finite-opening sensitivity without claiming crack propagation, pipe-wall fracture, fluid-structure coupling or pressure feedback across a two-sided break.

1.0
